name: ecommerce-management-system
description: Comprehensive E-commerce Management System with AI Features

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Run npm run db:setup after configuring your database'
